        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }

                    return;
                }

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>

<div data-type="0" data-title-level="2" class="oc-wysiwyg-container">
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">
<h2>About Council Meetings</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>Hindmarsh Shire Council operates in accordance with the <em>Local Government Act 2020</em>, and hold Council meetings monthly, generally on the first Wednesday of each month with the exception of January where no meeting is held.</p>
<p>A list of meeting locations and venues can be found below.</p>
<p>Council encourages members of the public to attend Council meetings or to view our Council meetings live through Hindmarsh Shire Council’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@hindmarshshirecouncil" target="_blank">YouTube Channel</a>.</p>
<p>Community members wishing to ask questions at council meetings may do so, in writing, at least 24 hours prior to the council meeting. Both the question and answer will be read out at the meeting. Questions may be submitted by mail, email <a href="mailto:info@hindmarsh.vic.gov.au"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">info@hindmarsh.vic.gov.au</span></a> or delivered in person to a council customer centre but are limited to two questions and 100 words including any pre-amble.  Offensive, trivial and repetitive questions or questions, which have been recently answered, may be excluded at the discretion of the Mayor.</p>
<p>The question must be accompanied by a name and the locality where the questioner resides or works, which will be read out at the meeting. By submitting a question, the questioner gives consent to this information being read out in public. Anonymous questions will not be answered.</p>
<p>There may be situations where, due to technical difficulties, a live stream of the Council Meeting may not be available. Whilst all reasonable efforts will be made to ensure that the live streaming is functioning, Council takes no responsibility for and cannot be held liable for, the live streaming or Council’s website and/or social media pages being temporarily unavailable due to technical issues beyond Council’s direct control.</p>
<p>Where live streaming is the subject of a disruption, Council will notify the public on both its social media channels and Council’s website (if those channels have not been functionally compromised).</p>
<p><strong>Relevant Resources:<br /></strong><a href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council/council-resources/policies-and-procedures/c009-live-streaming-and-publishing-recordings-of-council-meetings.pdf" target="_blank" title="C009-Live-Streaming-and-Publishing-Recordings-of-Council-Meetings.pdf" class="emphasis-box-1 document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Live Streaming and Publishing Recordings of Council Meetings Policy<span class="file-info">(PDF, 219KB)</span></a><br />
<a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/council/governance-and-transparency/2022_09_06-governance-rules-august-2022-update.pdf" target="_blank" title="2022_09_06 Governance Rules August 2022 Update.pdf" class="emphasis-box-1 document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Hindmarsh Shire Council Governance Rules<span class="file-info">(PDF, 409KB)</span></a></p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">

<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">
<h2>Council Meeting Live Streaming Disclaimer</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>The opinions or statements made during the course of a Council meeting are those of the particular individuals, and not necessarily the opinions or statements of Council. Council does not necessarily endorse or support the views, opinions, standards, or information contained in the live streaming or recording of the Council meetings.</p>
<p>Council does not accept any responsibility for the comments made or information provided during Council Meetings and does not warrant nor represent that the material or statements made during Council meetings are complete, reliable or accurate. Council does not accept any responsibility or liability for any loss, damage, cost or expense that might be incurred howsoever arising as a result of or in connection with the use or reliance on information or statements made in the live streaming or published recordings of Council meetings.</p>
<p>Whilst Council will use its best endeavours to ensure the live streaming and Council’s website are functioning, technical issues may arise and Council cannot guarantee that the live stream will always be available, or that recordings of Council meetings will be complete.</p>
</div>

                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">
<h2>About Council Meetings</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>Hindmarsh Shire Council operates in accordance with the <em>Local Government Act 2020</em>, and hold Council meetings monthly, generally on the first Wednesday of each month with the exception of January where no meeting is held.</p>
<p>A list of meeting locations and venues can be found below.</p>
<p>Council encourages members of the public to attend Council meetings or to view our Council meetings live through Hindmarsh Shire Council’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@hindmarshshirecouncil" target="_blank">YouTube Channel</a>.</p>
<p>Community members wishing to ask questions at council meetings may do so, in writing, at least 24 hours prior to the council meeting. Both the question and answer will be read out at the meeting. Questions may be submitted by mail, email <a href="mailto:info@hindmarsh.vic.gov.au"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">info@hindmarsh.vic.gov.au</span></a> or delivered in person to a council customer centre but are limited to two questions and 100 words including any pre-amble.  Offensive, trivial and repetitive questions or questions, which have been recently answered, may be excluded at the discretion of the Mayor.</p>
<p>The question must be accompanied by a name and the locality where the questioner resides or works, which will be read out at the meeting. By submitting a question, the questioner gives consent to this information being read out in public. Anonymous questions will not be answered.</p>
<p>There may be situations where, due to technical difficulties, a live stream of the Council Meeting may not be available. Whilst all reasonable efforts will be made to ensure that the live streaming is functioning, Council takes no responsibility for and cannot be held liable for, the live streaming or Council’s website and/or social media pages being temporarily unavailable due to technical issues beyond Council’s direct control.</p>
<p>Where live streaming is the subject of a disruption, Council will notify the public on both its social media channels and Council’s website (if those channels have not been functionally compromised).</p>
<p><strong>Relevant Resources:<br /></strong><a href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council/council-resources/policies-and-procedures/c009-live-streaming-and-publishing-recordings-of-council-meetings.pdf" target="_blank" title="C009-Live-Streaming-and-Publishing-Recordings-of-Council-Meetings.pdf" class="emphasis-box-1 document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Live Streaming and Publishing Recordings of Council Meetings Policy<span class="file-info">(PDF, 219KB)</span></a><br />
<a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/council/governance-and-transparency/2022_09_06-governance-rules-august-2022-update.pdf" target="_blank" title="2022_09_06 Governance Rules August 2022 Update.pdf" class="emphasis-box-1 document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Hindmarsh Shire Council Governance Rules<span class="file-info">(PDF, 409KB)</span></a></p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">

<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">
<h2>Council Meeting Live Streaming Disclaimer</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>The opinions or statements made during the course of a Council meeting are those of the particular individuals, and not necessarily the opinions or statements of Council. Council does not necessarily endorse or support the views, opinions, standards, or information contained in the live streaming or recording of the Council meetings.</p>
<p>Council does not accept any responsibility for the comments made or information provided during Council Meetings and does not warrant nor represent that the material or statements made during Council meetings are complete, reliable or accurate. Council does not accept any responsibility or liability for any loss, damage, cost or expense that might be incurred howsoever arising as a result of or in connection with the use or reliance on information or statements made in the live streaming or published recordings of Council meetings.</p>
<p>Whilst Council will use its best endeavours to ensure the live streaming and Council’s website are functioning, technical issues may arise and Council cannot guarantee that the live stream will always be available, or that recordings of Council meetings will be complete.</p>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>

<div data-type="0" data-title-level="2" class="oc-wysiwyg-container">
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">
<h2>About Council Meetings</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>Hindmarsh Shire Council operates in accordance with the <em>Local Government Act 2020</em>, and hold Council meetings monthly, generally on the first Wednesday of each month with the exception of January where no meeting is held.</p>
<p>A list of meeting locations and venues can be found below.</p>
<p>Council encourages members of the public to attend Council meetings or to view our Council meetings live through Hindmarsh Shire Council’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@hindmarshshirecouncil" target="_blank">YouTube Channel</a>.</p>
<p>Community members wishing to ask questions at council meetings may do so, in writing, at least 24 hours prior to the council meeting. Both the question and answer will be read out at the meeting. Questions may be submitted by mail, email <a href="mailto:info@hindmarsh.vic.gov.au"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">info@hindmarsh.vic.gov.au</span></a> or delivered in person to a council customer centre but are limited to two questions and 100 words including any pre-amble.  Offensive, trivial and repetitive questions or questions, which have been recently answered, may be excluded at the discretion of the Mayor.</p>
<p>The question must be accompanied by a name and the locality where the questioner resides or works, which will be read out at the meeting. By submitting a question, the questioner gives consent to this information being read out in public. Anonymous questions will not be answered.</p>
<p>There may be situations where, due to technical difficulties, a live stream of the Council Meeting may not be available. Whilst all reasonable efforts will be made to ensure that the live streaming is functioning, Council takes no responsibility for and cannot be held liable for, the live streaming or Council’s website and/or social media pages being temporarily unavailable due to technical issues beyond Council’s direct control.</p>
<p>Where live streaming is the subject of a disruption, Council will notify the public on both its social media channels and Council’s website (if those channels have not been functionally compromised).</p>
<p><strong>Relevant Resources:<br /></strong><a href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council/council-resources/policies-and-procedures/c009-live-streaming-and-publishing-recordings-of-council-meetings.pdf" target="_blank" title="C009-Live-Streaming-and-Publishing-Recordings-of-Council-Meetings.pdf" class="emphasis-box-1 document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Live Streaming and Publishing Recordings of Council Meetings Policy<span class="file-info">(PDF, 219KB)</span></a><br />
<a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/council/governance-and-transparency/2022_09_06-governance-rules-august-2022-update.pdf" target="_blank" title="2022_09_06 Governance Rules August 2022 Update.pdf" class="emphasis-box-1 document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Hindmarsh Shire Council Governance Rules<span class="file-info">(PDF, 409KB)</span></a></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">
<h2>Council Meeting Dates 2026</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">

<h2>Council Meeting Live Streaming Disclaimer</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>The opinions or statements made during the course of a Council meeting are those of the particular individuals, and not necessarily the opinions or statements of Council. Council does not necessarily endorse or support the views, opinions, standards, or information contained in the live streaming or recording of the Council meetings.</p>
<p>Council does not accept any responsibility for the comments made or information provided during Council Meetings and does not warrant nor represent that the material or statements made during Council meetings are complete, reliable or accurate. Council does not accept any responsibility or liability for any loss, damage, cost or expense that might be incurred howsoever arising as a result of or in connection with the use or reliance on information or statements made in the live streaming or published recordings of Council meetings.</p>
<p>Whilst Council will use its best endeavours to ensure the live streaming and Council’s website are functioning, technical issues may arise and Council cannot guarantee that the live stream will always be available, or that recordings of Council meetings will be complete.</p>
</div>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">
<h2>About Council Meetings</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>Hindmarsh Shire Council operates in accordance with the <em>Local Government Act 2020</em>, and hold Council meetings monthly, generally on the first Wednesday of each month with the exception of January where no meeting is held.</p>
<p>A list of meeting locations and venues can be found below.</p>
<p>Council encourages members of the public to attend Council meetings or to view our Council meetings live through Hindmarsh Shire Council’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@hindmarshshirecouncil" target="_blank">YouTube Channel</a>.</p>
<p>Community members wishing to ask questions at council meetings may do so, in writing, at least 24 hours prior to the council meeting. Both the question and answer will be read out at the meeting. Questions may be submitted by mail, email <a href="mailto:info@hindmarsh.vic.gov.au"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">info@hindmarsh.vic.gov.au</span></a> or delivered in person to a council customer centre but are limited to two questions and 100 words including any pre-amble.  Offensive, trivial and repetitive questions or questions, which have been recently answered, may be excluded at the discretion of the Mayor.</p>
<p>The question must be accompanied by a name and the locality where the questioner resides or works, which will be read out at the meeting. By submitting a question, the questioner gives consent to this information being read out in public. Anonymous questions will not be answered.</p>
<p>There may be situations where, due to technical difficulties, a live stream of the Council Meeting may not be available. Whilst all reasonable efforts will be made to ensure that the live streaming is functioning, Council takes no responsibility for and cannot be held liable for, the live streaming or Council’s website and/or social media pages being temporarily unavailable due to technical issues beyond Council’s direct control.</p>
<p>Where live streaming is the subject of a disruption, Council will notify the public on both its social media channels and Council’s website (if those channels have not been functionally compromised).</p>
<p><strong>Relevant Resources:<br /></strong><a href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council/council-resources/policies-and-procedures/c009-live-streaming-and-publishing-recordings-of-council-meetings.pdf" target="_blank" title="C009-Live-Streaming-and-Publishing-Recordings-of-Council-Meetings.pdf" class="emphasis-box-1 document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Live Streaming and Publishing Recordings of Council Meetings Policy<span class="file-info">(PDF, 219KB)</span></a><br />
<a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/council/governance-and-transparency/2022_09_06-governance-rules-august-2022-update.pdf" target="_blank" title="2022_09_06 Governance Rules August 2022 Update.pdf" class="emphasis-box-1 document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Hindmarsh Shire Council Governance Rules<span class="file-info">(PDF, 409KB)</span></a></p>
</div>
</div>

<h2>Council Meeting Live Streaming Disclaimer</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>The opinions or statements made during the course of a Council meeting are those of the particular individuals, and not necessarily the opinions or statements of Council. Council does not necessarily endorse or support the views, opinions, standards, or information contained in the live streaming or recording of the Council meetings.</p>
<p>Council does not accept any responsibility for the comments made or information provided during Council Meetings and does not warrant nor represent that the material or statements made during Council meetings are complete, reliable or accurate. Council does not accept any responsibility or liability for any loss, damage, cost or expense that might be incurred howsoever arising as a result of or in connection with the use or reliance on information or statements made in the live streaming or published recordings of Council meetings.</p>
<p>Whilst Council will use its best endeavours to ensure the live streaming and Council’s website are functioning, technical issues may arise and Council cannot guarantee that the live stream will always be available, or that recordings of Council meetings will be complete.</p>
</div>

        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }

                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();

<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">
<h2>About Council Meetings</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>Hindmarsh Shire Council operates in accordance with the <em>Local Government Act 2020</em>, and hold Council meetings monthly, generally on the first Wednesday of each month with the exception of January where no meeting is held.</p>
<p>A list of meeting locations and venues can be found below.</p>
<p>Council encourages members of the public to attend Council meetings or to view our Council meetings live through Hindmarsh Shire Council’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@hindmarshshirecouncil" target="_blank">YouTube Channel</a>.</p>
<p>Community members wishing to ask questions at council meetings may do so, in writing, at least 24 hours prior to the council meeting. Both the question and answer will be read out at the meeting. Questions may be submitted by mail, email <a href="mailto:info@hindmarsh.vic.gov.au"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">info@hindmarsh.vic.gov.au</span></a> or delivered in person to a council customer centre but are limited to two questions and 100 words including any pre-amble.  Offensive, trivial and repetitive questions or questions, which have been recently answered, may be excluded at the discretion of the Mayor.</p>
<p>The question must be accompanied by a name and the locality where the questioner resides or works, which will be read out at the meeting. By submitting a question, the questioner gives consent to this information being read out in public. Anonymous questions will not be answered.</p>
<p>There may be situations where, due to technical difficulties, a live stream of the Council Meeting may not be available. Whilst all reasonable efforts will be made to ensure that the live streaming is functioning, Council takes no responsibility for and cannot be held liable for, the live streaming or Council’s website and/or social media pages being temporarily unavailable due to technical issues beyond Council’s direct control.</p>
<p>Where live streaming is the subject of a disruption, Council will notify the public on both its social media channels and Council’s website (if those channels have not been functionally compromised).</p>
<p><strong>Relevant Resources:<br /></strong><a href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council/council-resources/policies-and-procedures/c009-live-streaming-and-publishing-recordings-of-council-meetings.pdf" target="_blank" title="C009-Live-Streaming-and-Publishing-Recordings-of-Council-Meetings.pdf" class="emphasis-box-1 document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Live Streaming and Publishing Recordings of Council Meetings Policy<span class="file-info">(PDF, 219KB)</span></a><br />
<a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/council/governance-and-transparency/2022_09_06-governance-rules-august-2022-update.pdf" target="_blank" title="2022_09_06 Governance Rules August 2022 Update.pdf" class="emphasis-box-1 document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Hindmarsh Shire Council Governance Rules<span class="file-info">(PDF, 409KB)</span></a></p>
</div>
</div>

<h2>Council Meeting Live Streaming Disclaimer</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>The opinions or statements made during the course of a Council meeting are those of the particular individuals, and not necessarily the opinions or statements of Council. Council does not necessarily endorse or support the views, opinions, standards, or information contained in the live streaming or recording of the Council meetings.</p>
<p>Council does not accept any responsibility for the comments made or information provided during Council Meetings and does not warrant nor represent that the material or statements made during Council meetings are complete, reliable or accurate. Council does not accept any responsibility or liability for any loss, damage, cost or expense that might be incurred howsoever arising as a result of or in connection with the use or reliance on information or statements made in the live streaming or published recordings of Council meetings.</p>
<p>Whilst Council will use its best endeavours to ensure the live streaming and Council’s website are functioning, technical issues may arise and Council cannot guarantee that the live stream will always be available, or that recordings of Council meetings will be complete.</p>

        (function () {

                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);

                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>

<div data-type="0" data-title-level="2" class="oc-wysiwyg-container">
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">
<h2>About Council Meetings</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>Hindmarsh Shire Council operates in accordance with the <em>Local Government Act 2020</em>, and hold Council meetings monthly, generally on the first Wednesday of each month with the exception of January where no meeting is held.</p>
<p>A list of meeting locations and venues can be found below.</p>
<p>Council encourages members of the public to attend Council meetings or to view our Council meetings live through Hindmarsh Shire Council’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@hindmarshshirecouncil" target="_blank">YouTube Channel</a>.</p>
<p>Community members wishing to ask questions at council meetings may do so, in writing, at least 24 hours prior to the council meeting. Both the question and answer will be read out at the meeting. Questions may be submitted by mail, email <a href="mailto:info@hindmarsh.vic.gov.au"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">info@hindmarsh.vic.gov.au</span></a> or delivered in person to a council customer centre but are limited to two questions and 100 words including any pre-amble.  Offensive, trivial and repetitive questions or questions, which have been recently answered, may be excluded at the discretion of the Mayor.</p>
<p>The question must be accompanied by a name and the locality where the questioner resides or works, which will be read out at the meeting. By submitting a question, the questioner gives consent to this information being read out in public. Anonymous questions will not be answered.</p>
<p>There may be situations where, due to technical difficulties, a live stream of the Council Meeting may not be available. Whilst all reasonable efforts will be made to ensure that the live streaming is functioning, Council takes no responsibility for and cannot be held liable for, the live streaming or Council’s website and/or social media pages being temporarily unavailable due to technical issues beyond Council’s direct control.</p>
<p>Where live streaming is the subject of a disruption, Council will notify the public on both its social media channels and Council’s website (if those channels have not been functionally compromised).</p>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>

<div data-type="0" data-title-level="2" class="oc-wysiwyg-container">
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">
<h2>About Council Meetings</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>Hindmarsh Shire Council operates in accordance with the <em>Local Government Act 2020</em>, and hold Council meetings monthly, generally on the first Wednesday of each month with the exception of January where no meeting is held.</p>
<p>A list of meeting locations and venues can be found below.</p>
<p>Council encourages members of the public to attend Council meetings or to view our Council meetings live through Hindmarsh Shire Council’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@hindmarshshirecouncil" target="_blank">YouTube Channel</a>.</p>
<p>Community members wishing to ask questions at council meetings may do so, in writing, at least 24 hours prior to the council meeting. Both the question and answer will be read out at the meeting. Questions may be submitted by mail, email <a href="mailto:info@hindmarsh.vic.gov.au"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">info@hindmarsh.vic.gov.au</span></a> or delivered in person to a council customer centre but are limited to two questions and 100 words including any pre-amble.  Offensive, trivial and repetitive questions or questions, which have been recently answered, may be excluded at the discretion of the Mayor.</p>
<p>The question must be accompanied by a name and the locality where the questioner resides or works, which will be read out at the meeting. By submitting a question, the questioner gives consent to this information being read out in public. Anonymous questions will not be answered.</p>
<p>There may be situations where, due to technical difficulties, a live stream of the Council Meeting may not be available. Whilst all reasonable efforts will be made to ensure that the live streaming is functioning, Council takes no responsibility for and cannot be held liable for, the live streaming or Council’s website and/or social media pages being temporarily unavailable due to technical issues beyond Council’s direct control.</p>
<p>Where live streaming is the subject of a disruption, Council will notify the public on both its social media channels and Council’s website (if those channels have not been functionally compromised).</p>
<p><strong>Relevant Resources:<br /></strong><a href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council/council-resources/policies-and-procedures/c009-live-streaming-and-publishing-recordings-of-council-meetings.pdf" target="_blank" title="C009-Live-Streaming-and-Publishing-Recordings-of-Council-Meetings.pdf" class="emphasis-box-1 document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Live Streaming and Publishing Recordings of Council Meetings Policy<span class="file-info">(PDF, 219KB)</span></a><br />
<a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/council/governance-and-transparency/2022_09_06-governance-rules-august-2022-update.pdf" target="_blank" title="2022_09_06 Governance Rules August 2022 Update.pdf" class="emphasis-box-1 document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Hindmarsh Shire Council Governance Rules<span class="file-info">(PDF, 409KB)</span></a></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">
<h2>Council Meeting Dates 2026</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">

<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">
<h2>Council Meeting Live Streaming Disclaimer</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>The opinions or statements made during the course of a Council meeting are those of the particular individuals, and not necessarily the opinions or statements of Council. Council does not necessarily endorse or support the views, opinions, standards, or information contained in the live streaming or recording of the Council meetings.</p>
<p>Council does not accept any responsibility for the comments made or information provided during Council Meetings and does not warrant nor represent that the material or statements made during Council meetings are complete, reliable or accurate. Council does not accept any responsibility or liability for any loss, damage, cost or expense that might be incurred howsoever arising as a result of or in connection with the use or reliance on information or statements made in the live streaming or published recordings of Council meetings.</p>
<p>Whilst Council will use its best endeavours to ensure the live streaming and Council’s website are functioning, technical issues may arise and Council cannot guarantee that the live stream will always be available, or that recordings of Council meetings will be complete.</p>
</div>

    <script>
        // OCNOW-11988 (Cursor): Proactively focus skip link when returning from browser chrome.
        // Must run inline (not deferred oc_main.js) so focus is intercepted before NVDA speaks footer.
        (function () {
            var awaitingReentry = false;
            var inertSupported = 'inert' in HTMLElement.prototype;

            function isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(node) {
                return node != null && !document.documentElement.contains(node);
            }

            function getSkipContainer() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-container');
            }

            function getSkipLink() {
                return document.getElementById('skip-to-content-link');
            }

            function applyGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = true;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    if (children[i] !== skipContainer) {
                        children[i].setAttribute('inert', '');
                    }
                }
            }

            function clearGuard() {
                awaitingReentry = false;
                if (!inertSupported) {
                    return;
                }
                var children = document.body.children;
                for (var i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
                    children[i].removeAttribute('inert');
                }
            }

            function isSkipLinkElement(target) {
                if (!target) {
                    return false;
                }
                var skipContainer = getSkipContainer();
                return target.id === 'skip-to-content-link' ||
                    (skipContainer && skipContainer.contains(target));
            }

            function focusSkipLink() {
                var skipLink = getSkipLink();
                if (!skipLink) {
                    return;
                }
                if (window.scrollY > 0) {
                    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
                }
                skipLink.focus({ preventScroll: true });
            }

            function scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus() {
                window.setTimeout(function () {
                    if (!document.hasFocus()) {
                        applyGuard();
                    }
                }, 0);
            }

            document.addEventListener('focusout', function (e) {
                if (isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget)) {
                    applyGuard();
                }
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                if (e.key === 'Tab') {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                } else if (e.key === 'F6' || (e.key === 'l' && e.ctrlKey)) {
                    scheduleGuardIfDocumentLostFocus();
                }
            }, true);

            window.addEventListener('focus', function () {
                if (!awaitingReentry) {
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
            }, true);

            document.addEventListener('focusin', function (e) {
                var reentryFromChrome = awaitingReentry || isExplicitlyOutsideDocument(e.relatedTarget);
                if (!reentryFromChrome) {
                    return;
                }
                if (isSkipLinkElement(e.target)) {
                    clearGuard();
                    return;
                }
                applyGuard();
                focusSkipLink();
                clearGuard();
            }, true);
        })();
    </script>

							              <!--normalTemplateStart--><h1 class='oc-page-title '>Council Meetings</h1>

<div data-type="0" data-title-level="2" class="oc-wysiwyg-container">
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">
<h2>About Council Meetings</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>Hindmarsh Shire Council operates in accordance with the <em>Local Government Act 2020</em>, and hold Council meetings monthly, generally on the first Wednesday of each month with the exception of January where no meeting is held.</p>
<p>A list of meeting locations and venues can be found below.</p>
<p>Council encourages members of the public to attend Council meetings or to view our Council meetings live through Hindmarsh Shire Council’s <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@hindmarshshirecouncil" target="_blank">YouTube Channel</a>.</p>
<p>Community members wishing to ask questions at council meetings may do so, in writing, at least 24 hours prior to the council meeting. Both the question and answer will be read out at the meeting. Questions may be submitted by mail, email <a href="mailto:info@hindmarsh.vic.gov.au"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">info@hindmarsh.vic.gov.au</span></a> or delivered in person to a council customer centre but are limited to two questions and 100 words including any pre-amble.  Offensive, trivial and repetitive questions or questions, which have been recently answered, may be excluded at the discretion of the Mayor.</p>
<p>The question must be accompanied by a name and the locality where the questioner resides or works, which will be read out at the meeting. By submitting a question, the questioner gives consent to this information being read out in public. Anonymous questions will not be answered.</p>
<p>There may be situations where, due to technical difficulties, a live stream of the Council Meeting may not be available. Whilst all reasonable efforts will be made to ensure that the live streaming is functioning, Council takes no responsibility for and cannot be held liable for, the live streaming or Council’s website and/or social media pages being temporarily unavailable due to technical issues beyond Council’s direct control.</p>
<p>Where live streaming is the subject of a disruption, Council will notify the public on both its social media channels and Council’s website (if those channels have not been functionally compromised).</p>
<p><strong>Relevant Resources:<br /></strong><a href="/files/assets/public/v/2/council/council-resources/policies-and-procedures/c009-live-streaming-and-publishing-recordings-of-council-meetings.pdf" target="_blank" title="C009-Live-Streaming-and-Publishing-Recordings-of-Council-Meetings.pdf" class="emphasis-box-1 document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Live Streaming and Publishing Recordings of Council Meetings Policy<span class="file-info">(PDF, 219KB)</span></a><br />
<a href="/files/assets/public/v/1/council/governance-and-transparency/2022_09_06-governance-rules-august-2022-update.pdf" target="_blank" title="2022_09_06 Governance Rules August 2022 Update.pdf" class="emphasis-box-1 document ext-pdf"><i aria-hidden="true"></i>Hindmarsh Shire Council Governance Rules<span class="file-info">(PDF, 409KB)</span></a></p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">
<h2>Council Meeting Dates 2026</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">

<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel">
<h2>Council Meeting Live Streaming Disclaimer</h2>
<div class="oc-wysiwyg-container-panel-content">
<p>The opinions or statements made during the course of a Council meeting are those of the particular individuals, and not necessarily the opinions or statements of Council. Council does not necessarily endorse or support the views, opinions, standards, or information contained in the live streaming or recording of the Council meetings.</p>
<p>Council does not accept any responsibility for the comments made or information provided during Council Meetings and does not warrant nor represent that the material or statements made during Council meetings are complete, reliable or accurate. Council does not accept any responsibility or liability for any loss, damage, cost or expense that might be incurred howsoever arising as a result of or in connection with the use or reliance on information or statements made in the live streaming or published recordings of Council meetings.</p>
<p>Whilst Council will use its best endeavours to ensure the live streaming and Council’s website are functioning, technical issues may arise and Council cannot guarantee that the live stream will always be available, or that recordings of Council meetings will be complete.</p>
</div>
